backgrounds.name: Salt Lantern Valley
backgrounds.description: Salt Lantern Valley viewed before Azure Cloud's fate is decided. The suspended mountain belongs to the opening period; later shared scenes use the tower square.

backgrounds.name: The Valley Archive
backgrounds.description: Original household ledgers wait beside the edited copies. Warm lamplight reveals the conditions a clean register omitted.

backgrounds.name: The North Landing
backgrounds.description: Spring rain washes a public jetty. Beyond the crossing stone, a ferry route enters fog that keeps a passenger's memories.

backgrounds.name: The Bell-Tower Square
backgrounds.description: A public square beneath autumn lanterns. This view faces grounded ridges and remains consistent with all three outcomes for Azure Cloud.

backgrounds.name: The Sheltered Reach
backgrounds.description: A high-bank mooring offers rest without opening a single entrusted echo. Flood marks make a promise answerable to the river.

backgrounds.name: Bell Keeper's Workshop
backgrounds.description: Clappers, cords, and worn tools wait in the room where the valley's bells are maintained.

backgrounds.name: Ferry Ticket House
backgrounds.description: Bamboo passes and a low counter make room for travelers arranging passage.

backgrounds.name: High-Bank Boathouse
backgrounds.description: An unfinished ferry rests above the old flood line among ropes and hull frames.

backgrounds.name: Stone Carvers' Hall
backgrounds.description: Carvers measure replacement landing stones beside a ramp through their workshop.

backgrounds.name: Reed-Case Workroom
backgrounds.description: Dry reeds and folded cloth line a room used for making protective cases.

backgrounds.name: Archive Copy Room
backgrounds.description: Copying desks stand apart so readers can work without exposing a neighbor's papers.

backgrounds.name: Archive Consent Room
backgrounds.description: Closed boxes and a screened table offer space for discussing records in private.

backgrounds.name: Village Council Room
backgrounds.description: An open circle of stools leaves every household a place in the meeting.

backgrounds.name: Salt Merchant's Store
backgrounds.description: Scales, sealed jars, and raised stores preserve the valley's salt through damp weather.

backgrounds.name: Winter Grain House
backgrounds.description: Millet bins and wicker scoops mark the food held for the coming winter.

npcs.name: Su Lan
npcs.description: The bell keeper has stopped ringing a ward that erases households. She remembers how her own certainty helped the injustice begin.

npcs.name: Wei Jin
npcs.description: A veteran ferryman keeps the disputed crossing open. He asks whose winter harvest will bear the cost of repairing a wrong boundary.

npcs.name: An Ru
npcs.description: An archivist preserves the original household ledger. Her seal identifies the evidence without asking the village to accept her conclusions.

npcs.name: Wei Xiu
npcs.description: A living ferry pilot and stone carver whose household was erased from the register. She charts a route without claiming the memories it carries.

monsters.name: The Reed Listener
monsters.description: A spirit beast shelters nineteen stolen names in paper nests, spending its own memories to protect strangers.

monsters.name: The Mooring Eel
monsters.description: A river spirit holds memories entrusted by ferry passengers. It can keep an echo, but cannot read unoffered thoughts or replace a living witness.

items.name: Su Lan's Bronze Clapper
items.description: Su Lan removed this clapper when the ward began enforcing altered records. Its silence is a deliberate safeguard. Inspection does not transfer custody: the keeper lends it only when she agrees.

items.name: A Sealed Echo Case
items.description: A returned echo can remain sealed. The case preserves a volunteered copy of a memory, not a missing piece of the owner's mind. Receiving it grants nobody else permission to listen.
